moments.action: Outside a neon arcade, the young American in the white shirt and the woman in the white fur collar trade close reverse-shots; her teasing smile fades to a steady look and his grin settles into something serious.
Cut to the Boutan pachinko doors: the long-haired man in the black jacket pushes out through them, walks the crowded arcade aisle and stops by the vending machines, scanning the street.
Back on the pair, the reverse-shots keep going; his smile tightens into a flat, searching stare and her warmth cools to a guarded, measuring expression by the last shot.
He turns away in dark profile, eyes down. A wide from behind him opens onto the neon lot with orange and yellow sports cars parked, and the fur-collared woman moves off toward the vending machines.
The long-haired man reaches a dark car at the vending machines and looks back, then a wide shows the black VeilSide coupe sitting low in the lantern-lit lane as he comes around to it.
A night skyline of lit towers, then through the windshield the two men are side by side in the black car; the camera moves inside as they pull away and start talking, city lights sliding past.
Riding through the city, the long-haired man grins and talks at length; the American listens, and across the held two-shots his face drains of amusement into a fixed, troubled stare out the glass.

The exchange drops into tight singles as streaked lights blur past: the American stares out, grim, while the long-haired man speaks quietly with his eyes closing; the American ends unsmiling, mouth open to answer.
